# Work Block / Task Closeout — <Task>

- **Classification, repository, task branch and scope:** SIGNIFICANT / ROUTINE (justified N/A)
- **Approved project spec/P and separate Project Critic + Owner decision:** exact SHA/blob or routine/legacy rationale
- **Exact stage W/Stage Critic/conformance:** exact SHA/blob or routine/legacy N/A
- **Deliverables, output dependencies and AC evidence:**
- **Reviewed source S:** Reviewer READY + Verifier PASS on **same exact S**, or justified optional routine N/A
- **Final delivery H:** actual S..H evidence-only diff and actual applicable CI (PASS/FAIL/PENDING/NOT_RUN)
- **Task final status:** COMPLETE / BLOCKED / CANCELLED
- **Working phase:** e.g. DELIVERY_READY in separate task handoff
- **Tests:** commands, numeric codes, paths/content coverage, negative cases and untested gaps
- **Independent reports:** original reachable Git blobs and any labeled authorized presentation corrections
- **PR:** NOT_CREATED / OPEN / MERGED / CLOSED; actual merge SHA/date only if verified
- **Separate stage acceptance/next stage, Owner merge GO, MVP/deploy/production decisions:**
- **Integrated memory:** NOT_REQUESTED / PENDING_RECONCILIATION / RECONCILED via authorized PR
- **Owned worktree:** PRESERVED / CLEANUP_PENDING / CLEANED only with separate cleanup permission

## Findings, residual risks and next action

Task COMPLETE can precede actual PR merge, and neither implies roadmap-stage acceptance or deployment. Never change frozen P/W for status; do not treat P READY as approval or synthetic CI as live PASS.
